title: Islamabad Significantly Raises Penalties for Hotels and Eateries
excerpt: The government has implemented a massive increase in fines for hotels and restaurants located in Islamabad.
body_html:
The government has taken action to sharply raise penalties for hotels and restaurants operating in Islamabad. Under the updated regulations, the financial penalties have increased significantly, with certain fines seeing a massive jump of up to 50 times their previous amounts.

This regulatory change targets hospitality and dining establishments within the capital city. The move represents a substantial shift in how infractions by hotels and restaurants are penalized by authorities in the area.
